# SlidesAI

> AI-powered presentation maker that transforms text into professional slides for Google Slides and PowerPoint in minutes.

SlidesAI is a freemium AI presentation tool that integrates with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, enabling users to generate presentation slides automatically using text prompts and ChatGPT integration. The platform supports 100+ languages and caters to educators, professionals, and students seeking to automate slide creation without design skills.

- [ChatGPT Presentation Maker](https://www.slidesai.io/chatgpt-presentation-maker): ChatGPT integration feature to turn prompts into professional slides in Google Slides.
- [SlidesAI For PowerPoint](https://msft.slidesai.io): SlidesAI PowerPoint add-in landing page with text-to-slides and AI PPT generation.
